tagline: Making thyssenkrupp an enabler of the green transformation.
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. The sector is industrial, not technological, so the selected master KPI is adjusted operational performance, key to industrial transformation and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales amounted to €37.5 billion in fiscal year 2022/2023, down 9% compared to the previous year.
kpis.signal: Declining revenue despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Total amount of new orders signed by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Order intake reached €37.1 billion, down 16%, reflecting a slowdown in demand.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating result, excluding non-recurring items to better reflect underlying performance.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBIT dropped to €703 million (-66%), weighed down by margin pressures in materials services and steel.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after investments, before merger and acquisition activities.
kpis.description: Free cash flow before M&A amounted to €363 million, a significant increase compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit or loss after taxes and financial charges.
kpis.description: The company reported a net loss of €1.986 billion, compared to a profit in the prior year.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 100,000 people worldwide.

ai_positioning.summary: thyssenkrupp does not mention any defined strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided document. The focus is on green transformation and decarbonization technologies.
evidence: No mention of AI or AI-related APIs in the report.
Cited innovations relate to decarbonization technologies and sustainable materials.
The CEO emphasizes the company's role in the green transformation, not in digitalization or AI.
